body: This incident provides a concrete root-cause candidate for previously observed relay visibility lag: GitHub-backed hot reads can become incomplete or unavailable under shared API quota pressure while writes and other backends remain live. Fixing read amplification plus stale-state semantics should materially reduce phantom lag.
